app.title: Save manager
lang.label: Language
warning.close_game: Close Stardew Valley before editing a save: the game would overwrite your changes the next time it saves.
index.title: Your saves
index.no_folder: No save folder found at {path}. Choose the right folder below.
index.no_saves: The folder {path} doesn't contain any save.
folder.title: Save folder
folder.pick_hint: The file explorer window is open. It may be behind your browser.
picker.title: Choose your Stardew Valley save folder
farm.title: {name} Farm
farm.folder_note: The save folder keeps its name ({folder}): it's an internal identifier the game never shows.
accounts.title: Players and linked accounts
accounts.help: Each farmer is linked to the platform account that created it (Steam, Xbox/Game Pass, GOG…). If you move from Game Pass to Steam, clear the ID to free the farmer: the first player who picks it when joining will take it over. Nothing else is changed.
stats.title: Stats
skills.title: Skills
skills.levelup: Show the level-up screen at the next night's sleep (recipes, and profession choice at levels 5 and 10)
inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.nothing_editable: Nothing to edit: tools and weapons have no quantity or quality.
friends.title: Friendships
friends.help: {per_heart} points per heart. Above {ten_hearts} (10 hearts), only a spouse can go up to {max}.
backups.title: Backups
backups.help: A backup is made automatically before every change (the {n} most recent are kept). Manual backups are never deleted automatically.
backups.confirm_restore: Restore the save as it was on {date}?
backups.none: No backups yet. Make the first one before changing anything.
flash.backup_restored: Save restored from {name}. The previous state was backed up first.
error.save_changed: The save changed on disk since it was opened. Close the game, reload the page and make your change again.
error.missing_tag: Unexpected save: <{tag}> tag not found in <{parent}>.
error.backup_incomplete: This backup is incomplete. Restore cancelled.
error.folder_no_saves: No saves in “{path}”. Choose Stardew Valley's Saves folder.
error.picker_no_tkinter: The folder picker needs Tkinter (on Linux: sudo apt install python3-tk). You can also type the path instead.
error.picker_failed: The folder picker couldn't open. You can also type the path instead.
picker.game_title: Choose your Stardew Valley game folder
game.title: Game data
game.help: Adding items, unlocking recipes and showing item names in your language need the game's own data. The app reads it from your copy of the game: nothing is shared or sent anywhere.
game.status.no_game: Game folder not found. Choose it below.
game.status.missing: Game found. Its data hasn't been prepared yet.
game.status.outdated: The game was updated since its data was prepared. Prepare it again to stay up to date.
game.prepare_confirm: The app will download StardewXnbHack (about 30 MB) from GitHub, then unpack the game's files into a "Content (unpacked)" folder in {path}. It takes a few minutes. On Windows, a window opens: press a key in it when it says Done. Continue?
game.manual: Type the game folder path instead
game.manual_help: The folder that contains "Stardew Valley.dll". In Steam: right-click the game, then Manage > Browse local files.
unpack.step.waiting_key: Almost done: press a key in the StardewXnbHack window to close it.
error.not_game_folder: “{path}” isn't a Stardew Valley game folder: it should contain “Stardew Valley.dll”.
error.unpack_busy: Game data is already being prepared.
error.unpack_download: StardewXnbHack couldn't be downloaded ({detail}). Check your internet connection and try again.
error.unpack_no_write: The app can't write to the game folder {path}. Run the app as administrator, or unpack the game manually (see the README).
error.unpack_failed: StardewXnbHack stopped before unpacking the game. {detail}
error.unpack_timeout: StardewXnbHack took more than 30 minutes and was stopped.
error.unpack_unexpected: Something went wrong while preparing game data: {detail}
inventory.no_game_data: Item names are shown as stored in the save, in English.
inventory.enable_game_data: Prepare game data to see them in your language.
